messages:
Carmen (Billing): Urgent: nightly invoice run produced some weirdness — missing reserved_capacity line items for some enterprise accounts and, separately, two customers got the same invoice_number which caused Stripe to reject one and double-charge in our staging check.
Dan (Backend): ugh. job id?
Carmen (Billing): invoice-run-2026-04-02-03. Sample pipeline output attached:
```
invoice_id: inv_20260402_1001
invoice_number: R-2026-04-02-42
customer: acme-corp
lines:
  - usage_compute: 800.00
  # missing reserved_capacity_credit expected: -400.00
```
Carmen (Billing): And another entry:
```
invoice_id: inv_20260402_1007
invoice_number: R-2026-04-02-42   # duplicate number
customer: beta-llc
lines:
  - usage_compute: 200.00
  - reserved_capacity_credit: -200.00
```
billing-bot: invoice-run-2026-04-02-03 completed with 12 warnings and 5 errors. Errors: MISSING_LINE_RESERVED, INVOICE_NUMBER_COLLISION, STRIPE_EXPORT_FAIL
Priya (RevOps): Do we have any finalized invoices pushed to Stripe yet?
Alex (Payments): A few went through before we caught it in staging: Stripe returned duplicate invoice_number error for one, which our exporter retried and accidentally created a draft for the same external customer id — potential double-charge risk.
Dan (Backend): Likely root cause: race between invoice-assembler and the credit-allocator service. Credit allocator writes reserved_capacity lines in a background job; invoice-assembler sometimes reads before credits are applied. For invoice numbers, looks like the numbering service cached a sequence and re-used it across parallel workers during high concurrency.
Carmen (Billing): Can we pause the export? Finance will not send statements until we ensure lines and numbers are correct.
Alex (Payments): Pause exports now. We should also mark all invoices with missing reserved lines and duplicate numbers as "manual_review" in the export queue.
Dan (Backend): I'll deploy a quick hotfix: make invoice-assembler wait for credit-allocator ack (simple sync) and add a guard that verifies reserved_capacity entries for customers with active reserved pools. For numbering, add a central atomic sequence (db row with select for update) to avoid collisions.
Priya (RevOps): After the fix, can we regenerate only affected invoices and re-export using idempotency keys? Also need a CSV for Sales so they can reach out to customers who might see statement changes.
Carmen (Billing): I'll compile affected invoice ids: preliminary 11 accounts missing reserved lines, 3 invoice_number collisions detected. Will share CSV to #sales-ops.
Alex (Payments): On double-charge risk: if Stripe already finalized an invoice we need to issue credit memos and communicate. If drafts were created, we can cancel duplicates before finalizing.
Dan (Backend): I'll add these tests: assert no invoice without reserved_capacity_credit for accounts tagged reserved=true, and sanity check that invoice_number is unique at generation time. Will push PR and staging canary in ~2 hours.
billing-bot: hotfix deployment scheduled by Dan at 2026-04-02T10:45Z.
Carmen (Billing): Thanks. Exports paused until QA sign-off. I'll draft customer comms for impacted enterprise contacts and post in ~3 hours. :pray:
